results.title: Acoustic Rooster and His Barnyard Band
results.original_title: Acoustic Rooster and His Barnyard Band
results.overview: A talented young guitar-playing Rooster comes to the Bebop Barnyard to join Jazz Greats Duck Ellington, Mules Davis, Ella Finchgerald, and Lil Herdin. Even though he's a star on solo guitar, he must learn new skills to play together in a jazz band.

results.title: Cheer to Life
results.overview: Jéssica is a simple young woman, dedicated to her job at an antique shop in Rio de Janeiro, but she feels her life lacks purpose. Everything changes when she finds a mysterious locket identical to an item she inherited from her late mother. Driven by the desire to understand the connection between the locket and her family history, Jéssica teams up with Gabriel, a distant relative who appears unexpectedly.

results.title: The Full-Time Love Rat
results.overview: Newly wealthy and disillusioned, Randall, a mobile game developer, asks his old friend Sarah out for dinner to tell her how he actually feels about her. She deflects the conversation, insisting a solution to his crisis of meaning could be to join the dating applications. Heartbroken, Randall follows Sarah’s advice, but this casual and dishonest way of life begins to have dehumanising effects on his mind and body. Without Sarah, however, Randall can’t find it in himself to stop, as he doubles down on the descent into ratty madness.

results.title: Emma and Bruce Willis: The Unexpected Journey – A Diane Sawyer Special
results.original_title: Emma and Bruce Willis: The Unexpected Journey – A Diane Sawyer Special
results.overview: Hosted by Diane Sawyer, the program offers an intimate look at Bruce Willis’s life following his frontotemporal dementia diagnosis, and the strength and advocacy of his wife, Emma Heming Willis.

results.title: Vair
results.overview: Fateh fires a shot—a murder, police chase, and revenge follows. But what’s the real mystery behind it all? Watch ‘Vair’ to uncover the truth!

results.title: ASALI: Power of the Pollinators
results.overview: An animated action-adventure short film that follows Asali, a little honey bee who is the survivor of the collapse of her bee colony, as she meets a colorful group of pollinator friends and a human environmental scientist. Together they unravel a trail of secrets to discover if they can save their home from a monstrous and deadly force that has been haunting Asali and her family’s past.  ​

results.title: Busted - LIVE at Isle of Wight Festival
results.original_title: Busted - LIVE at Isle of Wight Festival
results.overview: British pop-punk trio Busted takes the Main Stage at Seaclose Park for a high-energy, nostalgic set during the Isle of Wight Festival 2025. Celebrating over two decades of hits, Matt Willis, James Bourne, and Charlie Simpson deliver an electrifying 12-song setlist split perfectly between their self-titled debut and A Present for Everyone. Features massive live performances of chart-topping anthems including "Crashed the Wedding", "Air Hostess", and the timeless "Year 3000".

results.title: Cordero al Matadero
results.overview: Elena, a young housewife, is questioned by polices forces after she discovers her husband's dead body. Based on the original short story by Roald Dahl.

results.title: The Lace
results.overview: A devious apothecary sells poison to women who are desperate to dispatch their cruel husbands in Victorian England.

results.title: Nicholas Meyer: In Conversation
results.overview: An in-depth interview with the director of Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan, profiling the filmmaker whose work arguably saved the Star Trek franchise after the nearly-catastrophic challenges of Star Trek: The Motion Picture. Meyer recalls his complicated relationship with series creator Gene Roddenberry and tells of his initial inspiration for what many still consider to be the best in the Star Trek film series. The legendary filmmaker also reveals his secret to directing actor William Shatner and talks about the reason he did not receive screen credit as a writer on the project.

results.title: Live Stage Bocchi the Rock! at KT Zepp Yokohama/Zepp Namba(OSAKA)
results.original_title: LIVE STAGE「ぼっち・ざ・ろっく！」at KT Zepp Yokohama/Zepp Namba(OSAKA)

results.title: First Patrol
results.overview: The routine day of two small-town police officers, Pavel (22) and Michal (50), is turned upside down when, as the first patrol on the scene, they are tasked with securing the site of an extremely violent crime in a restaurant where hostages are still being held. Despite being professionals, they are afraid, they clash with one another, and they make mistakes. This police drama captures a first encounter with a mass shooting through the eyes of the very first responders.

results.title: Last Minute
results.overview: In the days before the Internet, a single mom must scramble to bail out her 12-year-old son when he waits until the night before to start a major homework assignment.

results.title: Just Keke
results.overview: A visual album by Keke Palmer, accompanying the album by the same name, which explores themes of personal growth, motherhood, and navigating public perception.

results.title: What Does Not Float
results.overview: Three tourists spend their summer holiday in Gijón. They visit the fair and have deep, existential conversations while having fun and getting drunk. The next day — slightly hungover — they go to the beach, where they experience a supernatural event.

results.title: The 6th Summer
results.overview: How do you deal with it when a loved one suddenly decides against you and can no longer be reached. Rosa spends her summer in her former boyfriend's street, on the wall opposite his house, to get the apology she thinks she deserves and is supported in this endeavour by the residents of the street. One day it turns out that her ex-boyfriend has gone on holiday and Rosa is encouraged to do the same. A journey begins with the obsessive attempt to have a good time and the question of how to say goodbye to someone who is suddenly no longer there.

results.title: Niederurnen, GL
results.overview: In a forgotten Swiss valley, an evil wind haunts the daily lives of former Italian asbestos factory workers, who still breathe its invisible fibers.

results.title: Trashy
results.overview: When fourteen-year-old Naomi reunites with her estranged cousin, innocent curiosities lead to a night of drinking, debauchery, and betrayal in the shadows of a small Ohio factory town.

results.title: Brother Forever
results.overview: A documentary about the phenomenon of the Brother duology and its place in the country's cultural code. Directors Anna and Grigory Selyanov explore Balabanov's legacy, rare archives, and routes from Moscow to New York to understand how these films united several generations of Russians.
